# Deployment
Well, this a small end to end system for a low cost (at most 0), so I couldn't use any paid services.
Yet, I tried to mirror real design pattern for a ML system.

## Architecture
- R2 buckets for storing data and models
- Render for hosting two services: API and the UI.
- Github Actions for CI/CD but also for triggering the cloud flow to retrain the model when new data is available.

## Cloud flow

- The admin add a .csv file in the UI after inserting a ingest token.
- The UI send the file to the API
- The API store the file in a R2 bucket and trigger a Github workflow to retrain the model.
    - first check if the file is valid, and is not present in the training data
    - then pull using DVC the training data and then merge the new data with the old one
    - Run again the pipeline and load using DVC the new data
    - For now the model after retraining is added using git.
    - the app is redeployed and the new model is used for predictions.


## Design Choices:
well, several:
- I used R2 buckets for storing data and models because they are free and easy to use.
- I used Render for hosting the API and the UI because they are free and easy to use
- I used Github Actions for CI/CD because they are free and easy to use
- I used DVC for versioning the data and models because they are free and easy to use
